label: Sticker rain
description: A SHOWER of die-cut stickers timed to a word: dollar bills fluttering down around a person grinning up at them ('money'), coins dropping into a pile, envelopes pouring in ('your inbox'). Pieces fall from above the frame, sway and tumble, and either pass out the bottom (mode 'flutter', the default -- paper, bills, confetti) or land on a floor and stay (mode 'pile' -- coins, objects). Name the sticker from the house library with `sticker` (e.g. 'dollar-bill', 'coin', 'envelope', 'money-stack') or mix several with `stickers`; a name the library lacks is drawn in the house style on first use (give `sticker_subject` to say what to draw). Full-frame over the scene -- lanes 'sides' keeps the middle third clear so it never covers a face. Time `at` to the spoken word. Example: {"sticker":"dollar-bill","count":16,"at":1.2,"spread":1.2}.

sticker.label: House-library sticker name (dollar-bill, coin, money-stack, envelope, star, heart, party-popper ...), or a new name to draw on first use

stickers.label: Several sticker names to mix in one shower

sticker_subject.label: What to draw when the name is new to the library (e.g. 'a cartoon chimpanzee face')

src.label: A transparent image URL instead of a library name

at.label: When the first piece appears (scene seconds, default 0.2)

spread.label: Seconds over which the pieces start falling (default 1.4)

fall.label: Seconds one piece takes to fall (default 2.2)

size.label: Piece width as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.2)

mode.label: flutter (default: sway and tumble through the frame) | pile (drop, bounce, land and stay)

floor.label: pile only: where they land, as a fraction of the frame height (default 0.94)

lanes.label: all (default) | sides (keep the middle third clear, off the face)

seed.label: Changes the pattern (same seed, same shower)
